description: This file defines the Psr16CacheAdapter class which implements the CacheInterface to adapt a PSR SimpleCache instance for use within AWS SDK contexts.

classes.name: Psr16CacheAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class implementing AWS SDK's CacheInterface by wrapping a PSR-16 SimpleCache implementation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the adapter with a PSR-16 compatible cache instance.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key via the underlying cache.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the cache with optional TTL.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the cache.
